answers.core: This is a core function for all scene nodes.
answers.workaround:
The lazy and obviously error-prone way is:
```gdscript
get_parent().get_parent().get_parent().get_parent().get_parent().get_parent().get_parent()
```

The correct way, is to make a Utils singleton/global, so as to basically call this function...
```gdscript
func get_recursive_parent_from_child(child: Node, parent_name: String) -> Node:
	var current_parent: Node = child.get_parent()
	while (current_parent.name != parent_name):
		current_parent = current_parent.get_parent()
		
	return current_parent
```

The function name `get_recursive_parent_from_child` is intuitive for the singleton/global, since it takes the child parameter, but obviously `get_ancestor` is better if the function is placed on the node itself

Ah and ofc, the above function needs some error checks (e.g. what if there are no parents with that name?)
I would suggest an optional int parameter, so it stops after that many iterations (so if it doesn't find one, it won't keep surfacing forever)

title: Add get_ancestor function for any node (recursive get_parent)
